name: Pastry
description: Solves engineering problems and performs research and native computer use.
setupNotes: Requires Antigravity with access to gemini-4-neon.
Computer use requires Ada computer use on a machine with a desktop session; browser work uses OpenCode Browse or Ada preview.
Project bootstrapping requires Git and Node.js; Go, Make and Docker are needed for generated project checks.
GitHub publication requires an authenticated GitHub CLI and explicit authorization.
Browser CLI workflows require playwright-cli and its browser dependencies.
Heavy builds and tests can run in a Davit box when the davit client and a host are configured; otherwise they run locally.
